source.note: Community sources, not official GGG data. The primary source is the legacy Mobalytics [0.4] reward table (page updated 2026-05-24); the project rechecked it for 0.5 on 2026-07-13 against VULKK (published 2026-05-18). Conflicting or question-marked entries remain hidden as uncertain.

notes: This file owns Runes of Aldur campaign-only guide fragments and guaranteed zone rewards.
guidePatches are inserted into the league-neutral base guide only when campaignLeague is runes_of_aldur.
Keep this file separate from campaign-bonuses.json: these are temporary/loot rewards, not permanent character bonuses.
duplicateInCurrentGuide marks legacy guide overlap; overlay still shows the guaranteed league reward for consistency.
For long-term cleanup, move old hardcoded league reward texts out of guide.json and render them from this file instead.
Every non-null guideZoneId must resolve to an existing guide card and use that card's canonical Russian name.
Scorched Farmlands is Level 4 in both current community tables; this is a high-confidence cross-check, not an official GGG statement.
Question-marked rewards remain candidates for future in-game verification and are not displayed as guaranteed.
